queries.p99_ttft_ms: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{target}[5m]))) * 1000
queries.p99_tpot_ms: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{target}[5m]))) * 1000
queries.kv_cache_util: max by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (dynamo_component_gpu_cache_usage_percent{target} or vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{target})
queries.kvcache_hit_rate: sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{target}[5m])) / sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{target}[5m]))
queries.input_length_observed: sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{target}[5m])) / sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_count{target}[5m]))
queries.output_length_observed: sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{target}[5m])) / sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_count{target}[5m]))
queries.pd_inbalance: sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum{target}[5m])) / sum by (job_id, rank_id, chain_index) (rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum{target}[5m]))
